desc_en: Vertical smile-makeover story set in a real Skopje Old Bazaar street and a clean dental room. One recurring hero patient moves through a simple, believable veneer try-in process: check, shade match, placement, reveal. Photorealistic, Balkan texture, no stock look, no readable signage.
music: Modern Balkan-pop beat with clean percussion and warm synths, 118 bpm, minimal and confident
vo_mk: Скопје, утро. Само сакам природна насмевка.
Преглед, боја и план — без компликации.
Проба на фасети, прецизно и нежно.
Еднаш гледаш — и знаеш дека е твоја.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic. In a quiet stone alley of Skopje Old Bazaar, signage-free walls and warm worn cobblestones. Our hero: woman, 28, chestnut bob haircut, beige trench coat over white top, small gold hoops, neutral makeup. Medium close-up, 50mm lens. She pauses, touches her lips lightly, nervous but hopeful. Soft morning sun, warm beige and terracotta palette, shallow depth of field, no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She exhales and gives a small, uncertain smile while lowering her hand from her mouth. Camera makes a gentle handheld push-in about 30 cm, keeping her face centered and steady.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Cut to inside a bright, minimal dental room with off-white walls and pale wood accents, no logos, no readable text. Same hero now seated in a dental chair, beige trench still visible at shoulders. Dentist hands only in clean white gloves hold a small mirror near her mouth. Tight close-up on her smile area, 100mm macro lens, soft clinical key light, neutral color temperature, clean highlights, simple unambiguous mouth and hands.
shots.motion: Dentist gently tilts the small mirror to inspect her front teeth while the hero opens then relaxes her lips. Camera performs a slow micro-slide left to right, maintaining tight framing on the smile.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Same dental room, same lighting. A stainless tray on a pale wood counter holds two thin porcelain veneers on a neutral ceramic dish, plus a shade guide without readable markings. Gloved hands enter frame, selecting a veneer carefully with tweezers. Macro close-up, 90mm lens, clean white and warm wood palette, crisp detail, no text or branding visible anywhere.
shots.motion: A gloved hand lifts one veneer with tweezers and rotates it slightly to catch the light. Camera makes a controlled push-in, focusing from tray edge to the veneer surface in one smooth move.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Back to the dental chair, same hero and same room. Tight close-up on her mouth and lower face, 100mm macro lens. Dentist’s gloved hands position the veneer at the edge of her front tooth; her expression stays calm, eyes softly focused upward out of frame. Soft diffused overhead light, natural tooth color, gentle shadows, no tools with logos, no readable text.
shots.motion: Dentist presses the veneer into place with a steady, gentle motion; the hero remains still and breathes slowly. Camera makes a slow tilt up a few degrees from lips toward her relaxed cheeks, staying close.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Same dental room, same hero, same outfit. Medium close-up framed through a clean handheld mirror: her reflected face fills the mirror, smiling naturally with improved symmetry. Background falls softly out of focus—off-white wall and pale wood only. 50mm lens, flattering soft key light, warm-neutral palette. Hands are simple: her fingers hold the mirror at chin level, no jewelry changes, no readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She breaks into a genuine laugh, then settles into a confident smile while lowering the mirror slightly. Camera performs a subtle pull-back to reveal more of her shoulders and relaxed posture in one smooth move.
shots.end_kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Match the previous framing and room, same hero and outfit. The mirror remains centered but lower, showing her full smile without obstruction. She holds a calm, confident expression, shoulders relaxed. Same soft key light and warm-neutral palette, clean background, no logos or readable text. This frame feels like the final reveal end card moment.
